facts.rationale: Preserves observed behavior while separating constant callback results from unverified dispatcher-side termination semantics.
facts.value: Disable's one-entry state table supplies lifetime-ticking animation, empty local physics, and collision processing that returns the OR of wall and ceiling reports. Damage-dealt, clank, shield-hit, absorption and shield-bounce callbacks return true without local processing; reflection returns the shared helper's result. These local bodies do not by themselves establish how the dispatcher consumes the combat-event Boolean results.
